audit.why: A 450-range charge with no escape value and a telegraphed 800-range fissure cannot contest Akshan's range; the lane read and the 54% win rate agree.
audit.corrected: Read stands; the pillar interaction below is what was missing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes name his abilities but never their cooldowns.
audit.why: Searing Charge is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s, Volcanic Rupture 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, Bellows Breath 12s and Call of the Forge God 140/120/100s. A spent Searing Charge means fourteen seconds where a melee tank simply cannot reach you.
audit.corrected: Kite Searing Charge (14s at rank 1) and step up in its downtime; a spent R is 140 seconds of free lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Volcanic Rupture's magma pillar is only ever treated as a threat to you.
audit.why: Heroic Swing hooks terrain, and Ornn's pillar IS terrain — so every Q he throws hands you a fresh grapple anchor in the middle of the lane, including in open ground where you would otherwise have none. The same pillar is what lets his Searing Charge collide and knock up, so the pillar is a shared resource: use it before he does. Bellows Breath applies Brittle to whatever it finishes on, which is what makes his follow-up CC hurt.
audit.corrected: His Q pillar is terrain you can Heroic Swing off — take the free anchor, and remember he needs that same pillar for the Searing Charge knockup.

edits.before: Your second passive shot plus Avengerang come online — chip a melee Ornn whose only ranged answer is the slow-traveling Q magma pillar he must walk you into to land.
edits.after: Your second passive shot plus Avengerang come online — chip a melee Ornn whose only ranged answer is Volcanic Rupture (9s), and whose pillar doubles as your grapple anchor.

edits.before: Punish his low mobility — his E is a short terrain-dash with no escape, so kite it out and never get walled off by his Q pillar
edits.after: Punish his low mobility — Searing Charge (14s) is a short terrain-dash with no escape value, so kite it out and swing off his own Q pillar

edits.before: E (Heroic Swing) gives you a poke-and-escape his short E terrain-dash can never punish — your strongest pure-laning level begins against an Ornn with no dash escape.
edits.after: Heroic Swing gives you a poke-and-escape his 14s Searing Charge can never punish — and his Q pillar is terrain, so he keeps handing you fresh anchors to hook.

edits.before: You own these stages: chip him with Q and second-shot strings, kite his telegraphed E dash, and he has no sustain to heal the poke.
edits.after: You own these stages: chip with Q and second-shot strings, kite the telegraphed Searing Charge, and he has no sustain to heal the poke.

edits.before: Ornn has no dash escape and no sustain, so this becomes free real estate once you have two abilities — but Level 1 is genuinely even because you only have one passive shot and Avengerang while he can drop his Q magma pillar to zone you off the wave. Don't walk into his Q line to last-hit; he wants to E-dash in for the knockup, then W (Bellows Breath) to shield, breathe fire, and apply Brittle so his next CC trades back hard. Q-poke him from max range, cancel the second passive shot for the move speed, and stay mobile so his single-target E never connects.
edits.after: Ornn has no dash escape and no sustain, so this becomes free real estate once you have two abilities — but Level 1 is genuinely even because you only have one passive shot and Avengerang while Volcanic Rupture's pillar zones you off the wave. Don't walk into his Q line to last-hit; he wants to Searing Charge in for the knockup, then Bellows Breath (12s) to shield, breathe fire, and apply Brittle so his next CC trades back hard. Q-poke at max range, cancel the second shot for the move speed, and stay mobile.

edits.before: Levels 3 through 6 are your lane. With E (Heroic Swing) you hook off any wall, swing around firing, and jump out before his Q pillar can box you in — use it to dodge his E dash and re-poke. He cannot catch you: his E is a short terrain-dash with no escape, and his Q pillar and W Brittle are both things you simply walk away from. Stack Q poke and second-shot trades; he has zero way to heal it back. At 6 your R is a ranged missing-health execute, so chip him and fire it from outside the line of his own ranged R ram — never stand where its knockup can land.
edits.after: Levels 3 through 6 are your lane. With Heroic Swing you hook off any wall — or off his own magma pillar, which is terrain you can grapple the moment he casts Q — swing around firing, and jump out before he boxes you in. He cannot catch you: Searing Charge is 14s at rank 1 with no escape value, and it needs terrain to knock you up, so deny it the pillar. Stack Q poke and second-shot trades; he has zero way to heal any of it back. At 6 your R is a ranged missing-health execute, so chip him and fire it from outside the line of his own ranged ram — never stand where that knockup can land.

notes: The Heroic Swing / Volcanic Rupture pillar interaction runs both ways and was absent from the page: Ornn's pillar is terrain, so it is a free grapple anchor for you in open lane, and it is also the terrain his Searing Charge needs in order to knock up. Brittle's exact effect is not in the kit text, so I described only that Bellows Breath applies it and amplifies his follow-up, without asserting numbers.
